ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE

Behind the image
19 / Snowlight
REFERENCE 5215.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 017
Art direction: Winter expedition editorial, bright cold sunlight, cool blues against warm blonde
highlights.
Photorealistic vertical close-up portrait of an original adult woman with messy, windswept
golden-blonde curls pinned loosely up, with strands blowing across her face, light blue-gray eyes
and rosy cold-flushed cheeks. She wears a chunky blue-gray knit scarf and a dark navy down jacket
with a silver zipper and snap details. Direct, calm gaze, slightly parted coral lips. Bright winter
sunlight with a pale blue sky background, strong backlight creating a golden rim on her hair,
snowy mountain atmosphere, cool blue palette with warm skin highlights, shallow depth of field,
35mm film grain, no text or logos.
20 / Leopard Fur
REFERENCE 5214.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 018
Art direction: Raw skin texture, luxurious animal print, soft natural light, intimate fashion beauty.
Photorealistic vertical beauty close-up of an original adult East Asian woman with long, loose black
hair parted at the center and blown gently across her face, a dense scatter of natural freckles
across her nose and cheeks, brown eyes with a calm sideways glance and soft muted rose lips. She
wears an oversized plush leopard-print faux fur coat with a gray-and-cream fluffy collar and bold
black spots, partly framing her chin. Pale white-gray seamless background, soft diffused daylight,
visible skin texture and fine hair detail, neutral earthy palette, luxury winter fashion editorial,
sharp focus on the eyes, no text or logos.
